title: 15 Hazelwood Field Plan

missions.name: Photo mission
missions.note: One waypoint mission. Hover, aim, fire a bracket at each point.

missions.name: Mission A · Orbit
missions.note: Own mission, POI on the complex center. Curved route through four corners, one lap.

missions.name: Mission B · Video
missions.note: One mission, five moves. POI on the SW building corner for V6; every other point has a set heading.

missions.name: Thermal
missions.note: Deferred. After dark, 7 to 9 pm. Heights are placeholders.

missions.name: Mapping
missions.note: Grid mission for the orthomosaic and model, midday when shadows are short.

P1.why: Lead image. Lit west and south faces, building centered with the park around it.

P2.why: Main entrance. Shaded all day in fall, so shoot midday or under overcast; bracket and expose for the facade.

P3.why: Clean overhead for the annotated site graphic.

P4.why: Four headings for the labeled location graphic.

P5.why: Close frame of the entry. Tele lens or crop at this height.

V2.why: One clockwise lap, camera locked on the complex center.

V3.why: Glide in over Hazelwood Dr and descend to the entrance. Same battery as P2.

V4.why: Straight up over the courtyard with a slow yaw.

V6.why: 90° arc on the SW corner, aimed by the mission POI.

V1.why: Rise over the Woodridge Dr trees toward the lit west face.

V5.why: Pull back SW facing the building, tilt to the horizon.

T1.why: Radiometric grid over the full roof. Placeholder height.

T2.why: South to north pass, stills while recording. Placeholder height.

V7.why: Orthomosaic and model of the whole site, 75/70 overlap.

blocks: Mapping grid, then the clean overhead and context frames.
Entrance elevation and push-in in one battery, entry detail, then the rising top-down.
Reveal, hero bracket, the orbit (Mission A), vertical arc, close on the pull-away.
Roof map first, then the south-to-north pass on the east face.
light_note: The Suite 100 entrance faces north and gets no direct sun this time of year. Shoot it at midday, when the shade is brightest and most even.
checklist: Airspace checked on B4UFLY or Aloft; LAANC if Class C
Takeoff from the marked spot in the Hazelwood Dr lot
Batteries warm (cold day), hover 30 s before climbing
Camera settings locked: white balance, shutter, ISO
Lot clear of people and moving cars under the routes
Lens and gimbal checked; ND set for video
Thermal only: after dark, strobe on, dry roof
footnote: Altitudes are AGL from the marked takeoff in the Hazelwood Dr lot. TBD heights are still being set. Imagery ©2026 Google, Airbus, Maxar Technologies.
